seo_description: Bloc 11 Architects + Planners is an independent, multidisciplinary design practice in Indore and Bengaluru, working across architecture, master planning, interiors, objects and research.
contact_text: A practice across two cities. A conversation across many more. Use the slider to step inside our studios in Indore and Bengaluru.
notice_board: We are hiring — send your portfolio to info@bloc11.studio

capabilities.title: Architecture & Interiors
capabilities.text: Integrated architectural and interior design, from concept and planning through detailing, documentation and execution.

capabilities.title: Urban Design & Planning
capabilities.text: Larger-scale planning strategies integrating built form, movement, public space, landscape and infrastructure.

capabilities.title: Design & Build
capabilities.text: End-to-end project delivery integrating design, engineering, costing, procurement and construction.

capabilities.title: Building Engineering & Services
capabilities.text: Coordinated structural, electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC and allied MEP design for efficient and buildable projects.

capabilities.title: BIM Modelling & Digital Coordination
capabilities.text: BIM-based multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, documentation and integrated project delivery.

capabilities.title: Programming, Feasibility & Cost Studies
capabilities.text: Early-stage planning covering area programmes, site potential, feasibility, phasing and preliminary cost assessments.

capabilities.title: Furniture & Product Design
capabilities.text: Custom furniture, objects and products designed specifically for the project, space or user.

capabilities.title: Research & Visualization
capabilities.text: Design research supported by 3D visualization, material studies, simulations and digital tools.

capabilities.title: Installations & Virtual Spaces
capabilities.text: Installations, exhibitions and pavilions, and immersive virtual spaces and walkthroughs that let people experience a design before it is built.
